scope: Artistic refinement of the approved panoramic prayer-room design. Reference-only Pinterest browsing, never copying Pinterest images into the site.
searches: architectural light shadow plaster wall art
method: Used Pinterest search UI, opened individual pins, inspected their rendered images and accessibility attribution. Cross-checked named artists against primary sources. No Pinterest downloads, saves, reactions or posting. Actual preview/local-site rendering remains unavailable and was not attempted.

references.verified: Opened pin, viewed image and read attribution. Image shows flowing blue aluminum elements spanning an airport wall above service counters.
references.title: Field Lines
references.primaryEvidence: Artist identifies O’Hare Airport, Chicago; 2018; painted aluminum. Describes dynamic air currents and steady breeze.
references.application: One original abstract airflow/metal relief in existing airport orientation artwork slot. Adopt directional rhythm and low-relief material, not the artist’s composition. Keep departures information aligned and still.
references.rights: Inspiration only; no permission to reproduce source artwork assumed.

references.verified: Opened pin and viewed complete navy cyanotype with pale botanical stems, generous border and natural texture. Pinterest description identifies Henrietta Molinaro.
references.title: Large cyanotype prints
references.primaryEvidence: Artist lists botanical cyanotypes and all-rights-reserved notice.
references.application: Replace repeated campus photograph with a real public-domain archival botanical artwork by Anna Atkins; preserve full composition and museum credit. Science, paper and nature create a campus-specific mood without inventing an institution.
references.rights: Pinterest reference not reused. Selected public-domain Atkins asset documented separately in artful-art-sources-2026-11-04.json.

references.verified: Opened pin and viewed real hospital corridor: fine botanical linework across high white walls, pale green banners and generous blank areas.
references.title: Women & Children’s Centre, Shrewsbury and Telford Hospital
references.primaryEvidence: Official project page corresponds to Pinterest source and identifies project.
references.application: Keep hospital panels light, clear and calm; use one nature artwork beside concise practical guidance, never decorative medical test data. Selected actual public-domain Water Lilies painting is distinct from campus cyanotype and preserves original brushwork.
references.rights: Inspiration only. Hospital mural not copied or licensed; public-domain painting separately documented.

references.verified: Opened pin and viewed slender white layered relief with restrained warm light between sculpted layers. Caption is only Glyph; uploader MaWinkel.
references.title: Glyph (Pinterest caption)
references.provenance: Artist and whether photograph or render cannot be confirmed from the pin; do not describe it as a verified real installation.
references.application: Homepage-only original architectural relighting: a slender layered shadow at one outer wall edge, with room geometry, solid prayer niche, rug orientation and glass panorama unchanged. No extra floating ornaments or neon.
references.rights: Inspiration only. No source image reuse.

references.verified: Opened pin and viewed dark raised Arabic letterforms on a light exterior wall with long vertical strokes and strong negative space.
references.title: альметевская центральная мечеть (Pinterest title)
references.provenance: Location title observed on Pinterest; architect/calligrapher not independently verified.
references.application: Give the Adhan phrase deliberate typographic authority using accessible live text: stronger scale, calm line rhythm, higher weight and clear contrast. Preserve exact translated wording; Arabic must remain correctly shaped and readable. Do not copy the inscription or fabricate calligraphy in a raster graphic.
references.rights: Inspiration only. No source image reuse.

implementationRecommendations.home: One exclusive light treatment in existing room artwork, inscription as the focal point; retain the glass wall and calm panoramic context. Remove repeated subtitle/hero labels only where meaning remains clear.
implementationRecommendations.airport: Original gentle metal relief in the existing orientation art slot; keep explicit airport identifiers and departures board hierarchy.
implementationRecommendations.campus: Real archival botanical cyanotype in the existing orientation art slot, bounded full composition and a small honest caption.
implementationRecommendations.hospital: Real public-domain water-lily painting in the existing orientation art slot, quiet pale petals against deeper water, full composition and a small honest caption.
implementationRecommendations.motion: No animated line art, flowers or text. Art stays stable while scenic crossfades and scroll reveal preserve the approved calm behavior. Pause and reduced-motion behavior must remain.
implementationRecommendations.space: Replace repeated imagery, do not add more decorative sections; retain informative labels, captions, guide controls and opaque text surfaces.

failedOrExcludedSources.detail: Initial broad web search for Pinterest pins returned mostly guide.pinterest.com generic autogenerated design prose; not used as visual evidence or quoted.
Official page public-domain candidate, direct image blocked by browser; not downloaded or integrated. No bypass.
Monet Water Lilies image specifically non-downloadable despite generic Open Access footer; excluded.
